summary: The reel effectively uses the flat2d template style with clear illustrations representing the spoken text about Brazilian chimarrão. Minor text alignment issues and duplicate visual representations exist across sequential frames.

clean: Shot 0 accurately compares Argentinian and Brazilian mate visually.
Shot 7 correctly scales the enormous cuia relative to the figures.
Shot 10 accurately depicts the disgusted facial expression of the Argentine character trying chimarrão.
unclean: Shot 2: The map graphic is repeated identically from Shot 1 without new information.
Shot 9: Identical repeated frames for consecutive shots showing the exact same character pose.

clean: Good consistency in character hair, clothing, and flag placement.
Clear infographics explaining the fresh harvesting process of chimarrão yerba.
unclean: Shot 12: Multiple overlapping interactive buttons clutter the bottom interface area.

issues.problem: Consecutive shots (9 and 10) show identical frames without any progression.
issues.fix: Introduce a slight camera push-in or change the character's reaction angle.
Vary the zoom or show a regional close-up instead of repeating the map.

learnings.rule: Avoid repeating identical static frames across consecutive shots without visual progression.
Maintain correct relative sizing between oversized props like the cuia and the characters holding them.
